title: Planning intelligence belongs in a roadmap
body: The surfaced gaps span ask classification, parallel readiness, operator decision queues, release/documentation impact, and UX-aware planning/testing. A single implementation plan would mix unrelated substrates and acceptance shapes. This tracking parent keeps the strategic arc visible while child plans stay dispatchable.

title: V0 focuses on read-only planning recommendations
body: The first child plan should reduce operator cognitive load without adding mutating orchestration. `dontpanic next` and roadmap-vs-plan guidance surface what is ready and why; the operator still decides whether to dispatch.

title: Decision queue and UX-aware planning are future milestones
body: Pending decisions and design/journey verification are real gaps, but they have different substrates from parallel-readiness analysis. V1 and V2 stay trigger-gated until V0 is used and a concrete decision or UX-audit failure validates the additional surface.

title: Changelog gap is broader than schema changelog
body: DontPanic has a changelog skill and `claude/shared/CHANGELOG.md` for agent-conventions/schema changes, but no root product CHANGELOG or release-impact gate that forces README, onboarding, dashboard, architecture, and public metadata review. V0 should make that impact review explicit.

title: Roadmap tracking parent activated
body: Planning intelligence roadmap moves draft→active as a tracking parent. It has no features.json by design; executable work lives in child plan 2026-05-23-007. The child plan will be locked and dispatched through DontPanic.
